qin_bo.name: Qin Bo
qin_bo.title: Freight porter and rigger of Lark Pass

lark_e02_entry.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry.text: Before the morning applicant observation, Lin went to the ordinary clinic named on the lodging notice. The public waiting bench looked toward the gorge, where pale light had reached the freight gallery before the market roof. She had booked this current assessment in her advance reply to the association. Its price was three copper from her own account. A source record could establish what had previously been earned; it could not spare an unfamiliar employer from asking what her body could safely do now.

lark_e02_entry_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_002.text: The clinician asked about the shoulder before asking about cultivation. Lin described the cleared waist work, the limits on catching and her tiredness after the road. She did not offer a more impressive account because the clinician wore no sect badge. The ordinary examination began with touch, supported movement and questions about pain. Nothing in it claimed to see an unopened route or recover lost years. The clinician's hands found a small tight place beside the joint that Lin had been avoiding when adjusting the pack.

lark_e02_entry_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_003.text: Lin wanted to say the tightness had not affected yesterday's walking. The clinician agreed that ordinary walking was one observation and raised her arm only through the comfortable range. He asked whether she had tried to catch a falling load on the road. She said no. He asked whether she would know her present limit if she tried. She said the question described an untested action. He wrote that answer down without admiring it. He was building a current work note, not grading her ability to sound like a cautious applicant.

lark_e02_entry_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_004.text: The standing check stayed inside the four primary pairs and ordinary leg movements actually cleared under her earlier work. The clinician tested touch and supported balance before asking her to show any record. Lin's own raised expectations had made her forget how useful a chair could be in an examination. She sat while he compared the current sensations with the account she gave of the road. He did not call a stage a measure of how long she could remain standing without admitting discomfort.

lark_e02_entry_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_005.text: The note cleared comfortable waist-height ordinary handling in the inspected range, with a load and duration to be set by the actual workplace supervisor. It retained the exclusion of sudden overhead catching and any untested self-reinforcing grip. No powered trial was performed in the clinic. The clinician advised ordinary rest after the road and a separate low-load local assessment before using a strange instrument. Lin paid the three copper after the visit and received the written note with its date.

lark_e02_entry_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_006.text: Outside, a man was feeding a mule from a tin bowl held low enough that it did not have to twist against its tether. Lin watched the animal finish before stepping around the bowl. The mule driver asked whether the clinic had made her less worried. She said it had made one proposed job smaller. He laughed and asked whether smaller work paid smaller wages. She said the employer's terms had yet to answer that question. The driver tipped the last grain into the bowl as though this was an entirely sensible unfinished problem.

lark_e02_entry_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_007.text: Qin Bo met her on the public steps with his replacement-basket request under one arm. He had not abandoned his store duty to wait for her; his scheduled collecting route passed the clinic before returning uphill. The repair contractor had found no formal return entry beneath yesterday's informal note. Qin wanted a short witness statement before the committee closed its morning receiving. He had enough time to ask, but not enough time to argue all morning. Lin appreciated the limit and disliked how quickly it made the request feel urgent.

lark_e02_entry_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_008.text: She told him precisely what she had seen. The clerk and Qin had agreed where the broken ribs would be entered. She had not watched the subsequent formal ink appear in the contractor's receiving book. Her statement could support the earlier agreement and delivery of the ribs, not certify a later entry she had not observed. Qin looked disappointed, then said that was still more than the contractor's phrase about a forgotten conversation. He asked whether she would put that narrow account on paper.

lark_e02_entry_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_009.text: The applicant task's leader would begin at the next bell. Lin could write and deliver a brief observation now, refer Qin to the authorized receiving keeper without becoming his witness, or ask the committee to hear her short account at its later accepted interval. The first would take the remaining quiet preparation time. The second would leave Qin relying on the existing source dispute. The third would reserve part of Lin's later afternoon rather than borrowing a morning she had already promised elsewhere.

lark_e02_entry_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_entry_010.text: Qin did not tell her which answer a good person would choose. He showed her the actual request and said his household needed the basket repair date because two accepted loads still stood against his name. The contractor's supervisor would decide whether replacements could be issued before the source question closed. Lin could not promise the basket by signing anything. She could choose whether her own witnessed minutes became a document, a later appearance, or a fact she left the current keepers to compare without her additional service.

lark_e02_statement_choice.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_choice.text: Lin could offer only what she had actually witnessed: the ribs reached the desk and the clerk agreed where to enter their return. A narrow statement could change the contractor's comparison without proving the later book entry. She chose her own additional role before the applicant bell. Qin's basket, wages and repair judgment remained with their actual people.

choices.text: Write and deliver the witnessed agreement now; spend the quiet preparation interval.
Request a later accepted witness interval; reserve the afternoon for that appearance.
Refer Qin to the receiving keeper; add no statement or appearance of your own.

lark_e02_statement_written.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_written.text: Lin borrowed a writing board from the clinic desk after asking its attendant. She wrote the delivery she had seen and the agreement she had heard. The next sentence said she had not observed the subsequent formal entry. Qin read the distinction and asked whether the negative line could be shortened. She kept it where the reader would see it. He accepted the source he had actually obtained instead of asking her to manufacture the stronger one his repair problem wanted.

lark_e02_statement_written_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_written_002.text: They walked to the public contractor window on the way toward Lin's task. She delivered the signed short statement herself, so its receiver could ask whether she meant the ribs or the contractor's replacement stock. She meant the returned damaged ribs. The receiver attached the paper to Qin's source-comparison request and gave her a narrow receipt. It acknowledged receiving a statement, not accepting its conclusion or granting a basket. Qin returned to his ordinary collecting duty before the first freight cart came up the steps.

lark_e02_statement_written_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_written_003.text: Lin reached the applicant receiving without the quiet rehearsal she had planned. Her clinic note remained readable, and the task invitation remained the same; neither would benefit from pretending the missing preparation had happened. She asked the leader to let her read the local setup before explaining anything. He agreed to the ordinary reading interval already included in the observed task. The written statement now existed with its actual keeper, while Lin had to meet a new job without the private confidence of another practice explanation.

lark_e02_statement_written_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_written_004.text: The committee could compare her statement that morning even if she had no spare appearance later. If its receiver needed a new question answered, an accepted further interval would still have to be arranged. Lin put the receipt beside her own copies and left her afternoon unpromised. She had paid for speed with a small piece of preparation. It would matter if she tried to hide the resulting hesitation from the task leader or if Qin treated her paper as a replacement basket already issued.

lark_e02_statement_later.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_later.text: Lin read the committee's offered afternoon interval against the applicant task's finishing time. It allowed one short account after her prior observation was due to end. She signed an acceptance for that interval only and asked Qin to obtain its actual receiving confirmation. She had not become available for every later repair discussion. Qin took the request on his collecting route. Until the receiver confirmed it, neither would call the appearance booked or replace the missing written source with a promise that Lin would certainly arrive.

lark_e02_statement_later_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_later_002.text: At the applicant desk she retained the quiet preparation interval and used it to read the local setup. The later appearance would require its own time, even if the observed task left her tired. She told the leader about the accepted request before the afternoon could become an unspoken extra duty here. He said his own task would end at the listed bell and wrote that boundary beside her arrival. Someone else's inconvenience could become visible without requiring either person to give away a whole day.

lark_e02_statement_later_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_later_003.text: The contractor receiver returned a confirmation through its ordinary message runner. Lin's later witness interval was accepted. The committee would hear the source after its morning comparison, so Qin's basket request could not use her account in that first decision. He kept the morning request open under its existing records and returned to his work. Lin had chosen a more answerable source at a slower time. The delay would remain real even if the later hearing found her observation useful.

lark_e02_statement_later_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_later_004.text: She put the confirmed appearance into her calendar and kept its stated short duration. The task leader asked whether she now felt prepared. Lin said she had read the setup and would know more after seeing its actual use. His smile suggested he had expected an answer more concerned with the applicant's feelings. She had a morning in which to observe and an afternoon in which to be asked about minutes she had witnessed. Neither appointment created the basket Qin still lacked.

lark_e02_statement_referred.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_referred.text: Lin chose not to add her own written statement or later appearance. She showed Qin the public receiving contact named on his current repair terms and described the agreement she had heard without claiming the later ink. The keeper had authority to compare the actual books. Qin said he had already tried that window once. Lin accepted that the referral would feel insufficient to him, while still declining to promise time beyond the particular application interval she had come prepared to undertake.

lark_e02_statement_referred_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_referred_002.text: Qin folded the request more sharply than the paper needed. He thanked her for stating what she had seen and left before the collecting bell made him late. Lin did not call after him with a warmer promise she would then have to keep. A narrow refusal could leave a person doing the same difficult work he had already described. She kept that result visible in her own notes instead of converting her preserved preparation time into proof that the referral was the best possible answer.

lark_e02_statement_referred_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_referred_003.text: At the applicant desk she had time to read the local setup without reserving an afternoon appearance. The task leader would see an applicant who had prepared, and Qin's committee would compare the currently held sources without her additional document. Those were different consequences, not an invisible improvement to both people's day. She asked the leader where observers could leave their own bags so private papers would remain outside the freight path. He pointed to an ordinary locked shelf beside the viewing line.

lark_e02_statement_referred_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_referred_004.text: Lin used the shelf after checking its stated keeper and return procedure. Her own training book and clinic note stayed with her; the family letter remained folded in the secured bag. The extra private preparation made her first explanation easier. She could enjoy that advantage without claiming Qin had lost nothing by her refusal. His next repair receiving belonged to the actual contractor and worker, and she had chosen no new role there. Tomorrow she might still need to look him in the face.

lark_e02_task_router.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_task_router.text: The morning observation used the offered source actually admitted with Lin's application. Its leader had prepared the corresponding task rather than expecting every candidate to arrive with the same archive material. She showed her current clinic note first. Her historical fifth-stage record remained separate from the ordinary work the local supervisor would clear. No old outcome granted a load limit at this new gallery.

lark_e02_lesson_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_lesson_001.text: The task leader opened the teacher's permitted goat excerpt beside two empty freight baskets. One basket had a handle that projected beyond the frame; the other's handle folded inward. Lin was asked to describe the comparison before either moved. She began with their apparent equal width and stopped when the leader asked equal at which point. The old example made the oversight familiar enough to embarrass her. She drew each handle's position separately and left the unfamiliar timber passage out of the answer.

lark_e02_lesson_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_lesson_002.text: The leader placed a light ordinary bundle in one basket under his own cleared handling scope. Lin stood outside the load line and observed the handle settle outward against the binding. The changed width came from a particular loading condition, not a basket becoming dishonest. She wrote the before and after observations with their actual positions. The old teaching page would have been easy to recite. The local task made her produce an account that someone else could compare with the moving object.

lark_e02_lesson_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_lesson_003.text: He asked her to explain the result to a porter waiting for a turn. Lin offered more detail than the porter wanted, then noticed him watching the queue rather than her diagram. She asked which part would help before his basket moved. He wanted to know where the handle would meet the rail if the binding loosened. The leader kept that proposed failure separate from the completed demonstration. A useful explanation could begin with the worker's concern without claiming they had already tested the event he feared.

lark_e02_lesson_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_lesson_004.text: They tested the relevant clearance with an unloaded basket and a supported mock rail away from the moving freight. Lin was not asked to brace the rail or catch the handle. The supervisor held the apparatus under his qualified ordinary procedure. Her role was to record the positions and identify the untested loaded condition. She wanted the exercise to finish with a satisfying answer about the real gallery. It finished with a specific question the actual keeper would need to answer at the scheduled work station.

lark_e02_lesson_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_lesson_005.text: A shop apprentice reading the permitted excerpt asked whether the goat had eventually learned to carry its own basket. Lin said the offered comparison did not contain that story. He looked disappointed enough that she wished she could invent an entertaining ending. She told him the pass had actual basket carriers who might have better stories if he asked during an accepted rest interval. The task leader laughed and asked the apprentice to return the source page before its permitted teaching interval ended.

lark_e02_lesson_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_lesson_006.text: The leader's receiving note credited Lin's corrected account and marked her first overbroad equality claim. He also recorded that the demonstration used a supported mock rail and an ordinary light load. It had not qualified real timber, a loaded passage or a powered route. Lin accepted the written correction. The surviving teacher's example had given her an advantage in recognizing the mistake, while its familiarity had helped her make that same mistake confidently enough to need a local person to interrupt her.

lark_e02_lesson_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_lesson_007.text: The association would consider her for a comparison-copying role after reviewing its actual terms. No employment had been accepted yet. The observed task had ended at the stated bell, with its paid leader retaining the source reference and Lin retaining her own permitted notes. She returned the demonstration board and the borrowed pencil. Outside, an ordinary freight basket creaked against a different part of the gallery. Her new question could travel to its keeper, but the mock rail's answer could not stand in for the sound.

lark_e02_route_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_route_001.text: The route keeper began by showing Lin the public entry line and the closed branch beyond it. He did not ask her to identify a structural cause. Her task was a cleared ordinary walk with no load beyond her own small notebook. She read the starting condition aloud before they moved. Her old village note had offered a way to compare described access with an actual passage. It had not offered this keeper a substitute for his own inspection.

lark_e02_route_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_route_002.text: At the first turn the keeper asked her to stand where a waiting porter would stand. The view of the next load signal disappeared behind a hanging cloth. Lin had passed beneath the cloth without noticing because she was looking toward the steps. She recorded the blocked view as an observation at that position. The keeper moved the cloth within its existing tie and asked her to look again. The view changed; the cause of every past missed signal remained a different question.

lark_e02_route_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_route_003.text: They reached a resting place whose bench was dry but whose approach narrowed around stacked empty baskets. Lin could pass easily without a load. The keeper asked her to imagine a basket and she began estimating its width from memory. He told her to wait for an actual empty basket belonging to the next scheduled task. Its ordinary carrier held it where the turn required. Lin saw the handle meet the stack before the carrier's feet needed to change. Her own easy walk had been an incomplete measure of access.

lark_e02_route_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_route_004.text: The keeper directed the authorized stacking crew to clear one marked line under its normal duty. Lin did not move the baskets or take credit for the crew's ordinary work. She recorded the requested change and waited until the keeper received the cleared passage. They repeated the unloaded comparison with the actual carrier. A visible improvement had occurred without qualifying a heavier basket, repairing the gallery or proving why previous shifts had tolerated the stack. Those questions retained their own sources and responsible people.

lark_e02_route_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_route_005.text: At the closed branch a worker shouted an answer to a question Lin had not asked. He said the inspector would blame their shoes again. The keeper asked him to speak from the cleared landing if he wanted a note carried to the supervisor. He refused the invitation and went back to his accepted work. Lin left his named opinion out of the record. His irritation mattered to her understanding of the pass, but a shouted remark beside a closed passage was not the offered testimony her task had been authorized to receive.

lark_e02_route_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_route_006.text: The route note marked Lin's first observation and the actual repeated comparison after the keeper's ordinary request. Its scope stayed with the dated cleared walk. The clinic's waist-work limit had not been tested under a load, and her fifth-stage pairs had not supplied one. The keeper thanked her for asking what the carrier needed before drawing a general route conclusion. She knew she would remember the compliment. She also knew the corrected view mattered more than whether she could repeat his words at an employment interview.

lark_e02_route_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_route_007.text: The association would consider her for a bounded route-recording role after offering actual employment terms. The applicant observation ended at the listed bell, and the keeper returned her permitted source note. Lin left the actual baskets with their ordinary carrier and the gallery's condition with its qualified keeper. The old surviving village approach had opened this different work here. The pass had answered with a cloth, a stack and a person's carried width, rather than an invitation to call every walkway familiar.

lark_e02_dispatch_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_dispatch_001.text: The wage reader placed three offered dispatch tags before Lin and asked which had reached its receiving point. One recorded a booking, one a departure, and one a completed delivery countersigned at the named desk. All three bore the same supplier's seal. Lin identified the last as evidence of actual receiving and kept the other two as evidence of different completed scopes. The old courier example had opened this application, but the new tags had their own agreed payment terms.

lark_e02_dispatch_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_dispatch_002.text: One local departure had been canceled after its load was withdrawn. Its tag showed accepted waiting and no delivered basket. The supplier's ordinary terms paid that stated waiting scope. Lin almost compared the amount directly with He Xi's two-copper cancellation booking, then stopped. Different employers had bought different work. The old permitted example could teach her to ask where payment followed receiving; it could not convert one courier's amount into a universal price for every person's canceled day.

lark_e02_dispatch_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_dispatch_003.text: The reader asked her to explain the difference to a carrier disputing his latest slip. He had been paid for a departure but believed the record described a delivery he had not performed. Lin asked whether he wanted the difference entered as a correction question. He did. She wrote his offered observation and its named source, then gave it to the actual wage reader. She did not decide the payment or copy a household address from the adjoining packet merely because the carrier's own tag was open.

lark_e02_dispatch_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_dispatch_004.text: The reader found that a clerk had attached the wrong scope label to the correct paid amount. Its correction made the receiving record accurate without adding another wage. The carrier looked relieved, then asked whether next week's terms could pay more for waiting. That was a new employment question. Lin recorded it for the actual proposed-terms discussion instead of treating a correct old amount as proof that the old bargain was generous. The carrier took his corrected copy and returned to the load line.

lark_e02_dispatch_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_dispatch_005.text: An apprentice wanted to know whether every supplier seal should now be distrusted. Lin said the seal identified the source of each tag. It had not erased the differences among booking, departure and delivery written beneath it. The apprentice read the three scope lines again, more slowly. The wage reader asked Lin to shorten her explanation before the next carrier arrived. A careful answer could still take too long for the actual person who needed it, particularly when his next departure would not wait for a pleasant lesson.

lark_e02_dispatch_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_dispatch_006.text: The observed task's receiving credited the scope distinctions and marked her initial temptation to compare unrelated cancellation prices. The tags remained with their authorized wage keeper. Lin retained only the permitted comparison note, with private addresses excluded. Her clinic's physical limits had been kept visible even though this morning's job required ordinary reading. A reader might later be asked to carry an inconvenient load; an easy desk interval did not remove the bodily line from the worker's record.

lark_e02_dispatch_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_dispatch_007.text: The association would consider her for a bounded dispatch-comparison role after stating its actual employment terms. No continuing appointment or wage had appeared simply because the reader liked her correction. Lin returned the tags and the desk's ordinary magnifying glass at the listed bell. The old timely household replies had led her into a room where words changed what counted as completed work. Their value remained concrete, alongside the teaching collection and local approach that her original storm choice had not preserved.

lark_e02_after_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_001.text: At the ending bell, the leader asked all applicants to read their receiving place back from the invitation. Lin corrected its abbreviated stair name against the offered notice and received that observed comparison. Any earlier particular task kept its own scope. Then she ate at the market stair instead of explaining the morning on an empty stomach. She still lacked employment terms and Duan Zhi's instruction days. A basket of onions passed overhead, its smell reaching her before the load signal.

lark_e02_after_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_002.text: Jiang Tao arrived at the public desk with two survey workers and a damp cover wrapped around his own instruments. His local appointment covered a defined inspection of the association's lower signal stations. It did not extend his earlier commission into every pass along the road. He greeted Lin, noticed the clinic note and asked to read its current scope before discussing a relay observation. She handed it over. Familiarity had saved the introduction, but it had saved neither the local inspection nor the need to understand her present limits.

lark_e02_after_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_003.text: Jiang's instrument cover smelled of wet wool. A young survey worker apologized for letting its edge drag against a water jar. Jiang asked whether water had touched the isolated contacts or only the removable outer cloth. The worker checked the actual package before answering. Lin watched him distinguish an embarrassing mishap from damage that had not been established. He could have made a more alarming story of the apology. Instead he had asked for the information that would decide whether the instrument needed drying, reassessment or another cover.

lark_e02_after_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_004.text: The qualified station check would begin after the association received its inspection terms. Lin might be invited to observe a stopped reference command later; no input was proposed for today. Jiang retained the instrument, fuel custody and control judgment. She asked whether the gallery's bell sound traveled late because its rope drive was wrong. He asked her to describe where she had seen the rigger and where she had heard the sound. She gave the two positions. They could examine ordinary distance and the actual drive before selecting a cause.

lark_e02_after_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_005.text: At the market railing, the association's public scale weighed a sack whose owner protested that its damp cover should not count as grain. The attendant removed the empty cover under the scale's ordinary procedure and weighed it separately. Lin wanted to stop and admire another clean comparison. Then the owner asked where to put the grain while the cover dried, and the attendant pointed toward a shed that was already full. A correct weight had settled one dispute while leaving the practical problem that had made the dispute urgent.

lark_e02_after_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_006.text: She helped the owner ask the shed keeper about a stated short storage place rather than lifting the sack herself. The keeper offered space after the next accepted collection, not immediately. The owner chose to wait with the sack beneath his own awning. Lin had supplied a useful contact without supplying a roof. She sat at the railing until Jiang finished arranging the inspection notice. The pass kept returning her to questions whose good answers still required ordinary people to do inconvenient work.

lark_e02_after_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_007.text: Chen came from the committee room carrying a list of proposed employment accounts. He showed Lin the public draft rather than the private supplier appendix. Six hundred copper had been proposed for one twenty-four-week work-and-instruction place, with categories the members were still reviewing. It was not an offer she could accept today. He wanted her to read the physical job limits before the committee voted tomorrow. Her current ordinary assessment might prevent the supplier from pretending its most strenuous station suited every fifth-stage applicant.

lark_e02_after_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_008.text: The draft separated ordinary work wages, meals and lodging, qualified instruction and calibration, ordinary care, and evacuation materials. It did not call one full purse an unlimited training place. Lin marked a question about what happened to wages when a qualified clinician required reduced duty. Chen marked another about who received unused instruction money if an examiner stopped the curriculum. Neither answer could be created by the clerk writing supportive in the margin. Tomorrow's accepted terms would need responsible receivers and actual limits.

lark_e02_after_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_009.text: Lin read the draft's reference to an overhead basket guide and showed Chen the exclusion in her clinic note. He said the committee might replace that duty with lower copying or route work if it chose to hire her. It might also choose another applicant. Lin disliked the second possibility and said so. Chen seemed pleased that she did not describe honesty as a charm guaranteed to purchase good employment. He took the scope question into his comparison cover without promising which person would receive the job.

lark_e02_after_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_after_010.text: The contractor's receiving runner approached the market stair while they were finishing. Qin's basket request had now reached a different point according to the additional source role Lin had actually chosen. She put the employment draft aside before reading it. A possible new job did not make the worker's earlier request less real. The runner brought the proper narrow receiving, and she waited to learn what her statement, later appearance or refusal had changed.

lark_e02_statement_result_gate.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_statement_result_gate.text: The repair source comparison had used Lin's actual chosen contribution. Its receiver could enter a written observation, receive a later accepted appearance, or proceed without either. The contractor still owned the replacement decision, and Qin still owned his account of the promised work. Lin opened the receiving for the role she had undertaken rather than supplying the more convenient contribution afterward.

lark_e02_written_result_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_written_result_001.text: The morning committee had compared Lin's written observation with the clerk's retained informal note. It accepted that the damaged ribs had reached the desk and that the formal return had been agreed. The book correction went to the authorized receiving keeper, who had now completed it. The contractor approved one replacement basket from the current stock for Qin's next morning collection. Lin's paper had reached the comparison before that stock assignment closed. It had not turned her into the repair authority.

lark_e02_written_result_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_written_result_002.text: Qin would still have to inspect and receive the actual replacement before carrying a load. His remaining accepted bookings had their own scope and payment. The contractor's slip promised no second basket today. Lin showed Chen the limited result and said she had nearly omitted the line about the later entry she had not witnessed. He told her the useful part was that the committee could compare her account with its own record. A stronger invented statement might have made that comparison less usable.

lark_e02_written_result_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_written_result_003.text: The receiving runner gave her a copy of the statement's use and took the committee original back to its keeper. Her afternoon remained free of an appearance she had never accepted. She could finish reading the employment draft before tomorrow. Qin's earlier opportunity had changed, and so had her preparation. Lin folded the slips separately.

lark_e02_later_result_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_later_result_001.text: The morning committee had assigned the current replacement stock before receiving Lin's later account. Qin's request remained open without a basket allocated to the next first collection. At the accepted afternoon interval, she appeared and described the desk delivery and agreement, keeping the unwitnessed formal entry separate. The authorized keeper compared his informal note and corrected the book after hearing her. A new receiving date would follow the contractor's next stock arrival. The earlier lost collection could not be recovered by a useful account offered later.

lark_e02_later_result_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_later_result_002.text: Qin asked whether she had been given enough time to speak. She had, and said so. He thanked her, then said the delayed basket would make the first load's wage unavailable unless the dispatcher accepted another route. Lin could not offer the missing basket or decide that new contract. Her appearance had made the source question answerable with direct questions, while its slower date carried a cost. She stayed through the listed receiving and left when the actual receiver closed the interval.

lark_e02_later_result_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_later_result_003.text: Back at the market stair, the employment draft was no longer available for the quiet reading Chen had offered earlier. He gave her the public copy to take to her lodging instead. She would read after supper. That difference was smaller than Qin's lost collection but remained part of the afternoon she had reserved. Lin had performed the promised appearance, not made every outcome arrive at its earliest possible time. She kept the dated basket request beside her witness receiving.

lark_e02_referred_result_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_referred_result_001.text: The morning committee had compared its held sources without Lin's additional statement. lark_e02_referred_result_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_referred_result_002.text: Qin met her at the stair after completing his collecting route. He did not ask her to reverse the decision by claiming she had delivered a paper. lark_e02_referred_result_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_referred_result_003.text: Lin retained the quiet afternoon reading time for the employment draft. lark_e02_evening_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_evening_002.text: On the steps she found an ordinary scrap of basket binding caught beneath a rail. She showed it to the keeper instead of treating it as proof of a dangerous defect. That fatigue was a reason to stop working, not a reason to begin guessing.

lark_e02_evening_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_evening_003.text: She received the lodging kitchen's included bowl of noodles and asked the cook which northern grain her mother would dislike most. She wrote their texture later without claiming they predicted the quality of every bowl. It was a frivolous comparison after a day of freight questions. lark_e02_evening_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_evening_004.text: The lodging keeper asked whether the clinic had cleared her for carrying his broken bench downstairs. lark_e02_evening_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e02_evening_005.text: At her table Lin placed three dated papers in order: the current ordinary assessment, the morning task receiving and the later employment questions. Those limits did not make the coming months small. They made the next morning particular enough that she could choose and perform its work without claiming it had already happened.
